visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright, modern indoor studio environment. A young Asian man with short dark hair, wearing a green long-sleeved sweatshirt, addresses the camera with a friendly expression. He holds a compact black action camera, rotating it to show its dual lenses and sleek design to the viewer. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor parking lot adjacent to a harbor. The man is standing next to a white Mercedes-Benz convertible, gesturing towards it. A close-up shot follows, showing a black metal mounting bracket firmly attached to the headrest of the passenger seat, holding the 360 camera. (3) A fast-paced montage commences, showing the car being driven through various scenic locations. Initially, the car travels along a narrow road through a snowy forest with vibrant autumn foliage. The camera is positioned behind the driver, capturing his head and shoulders as he steers the car. (4) The montage continues with the car driving along a sandy beach under a clear blue sky, then through a city at night with neon lights and a large Ferris wheel visible. Subsequent shots show the car entering a ferry, driving on coastal highways at sunset, and crossing vast grassy plains with mountains in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a crisp, clear male voice narrating in Mandarin. His tone is enthusiastic and professional, set against a bright electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat. (2) As the video cuts to the car parking lot, a subtle percussive stinger or transition sound effect marks the shift. The narration continues at a moderately fast pace, explaining the equipment. (3) Upon entering the montage, the BGM swells in volume, becoming a driving synth-pop track with prominent percussive elements. The speaker's voice is perfectly balanced over the music, with high articulation clarity. (4) Throughout the driving scenes, the audio is dominated by the energetic music track, with very faint, low-frequency ambient hum indicative of a moving vehicle, providing a sense of immersion. Technical sound effects like short 'whooshes' are used occasionally to sync with rapid visual cuts.
